{"claim": "Data were collected with Network Canvas and the survey had two sections for individual measures and directed friendship nominations.", "quotes": [{"text": "The survey consisted of two primary sections: the first collected demographic information, measures of AI identity, depression, and substance use; the second collected directed friendship nominations.", "page": 7}, {"text": "We used Network Canvas, a software platform designed for collecting social network data.", "page": 7}]},
